name: Questions example — two pictures, then a rating, a choice, a slider and a typed answer
notes: Shows the questions task. After two pictures the participant answers four
questions on screen: a 7-point rating, a choice, a slider with no starting
position, and an optional typed answer. Each answer is logged as a
`response` event with its reaction time on the master clock.
The typed answer is opt-in (disclosure.free_text) because typed text can
carry a name or a diagnosis; the consent screen says so, and exports leave
typed answers out unless asked (npm run export -- --include-free-text).

disclosure.secondary_use: Analysed by the named research team only. Not sold, and not shared outside the team without a further, separate agreement.
disclosure.contact: Replace this with the investigator and the route to the ethics board before running anyone other than the developer.
